variants.prompt: Bathed in the soft, sensual glow of candlelight, this alluring woman reclines on a plush four-poster bed, her raven tresses spilling across the luxurious linens. She wears a barely-there, black lace bikini that leaves little to the imagination, the delicate fabric clinging to her every curve. Emerald eyes sparkle with mischief as she gazes up at the camera, a playful, teasing smile on her full lips. The shallow depth of field and blurred candle flames create a dreamy, intimate atmosphere.
